Name: Farmer's Notebook
Author: gicantador
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Farmer's Notebook[/b][/size]
[i]An In-Game Planner, Calendar & Journal for Stardew Valley 1.6 — v3.2.2[/i][/center]

[line]

Stardew Valley quietly asks you to remember a lot: birthdays, festivals, planting windows, seasonal deadlines, fish schedules, Community Center progress, your own goals. Most players end up alt-tabbing to the wiki constantly.

Farmer's Notebook puts all of that inside the game, in a notebook that actually feels like it belongs there.

[b]Press N. Your notebook opens. Everything you need is right there.[/b]

[line]

[size=5][b]✨ An Interface That Feels Like It Belongs[/b][/size]

Farmer's Notebook isn't just a menu — it's designed to look and feel like your farmer's personal notebook.

[list]
[*]Leather cover with spiral-bound design[/*]
[*]Six colored bookmark tabs[/*]
[*]Decorative stickers and page illustrations[/*]
[*]Layouts unique to each save file, persistent between sessions[/*]
[/list]
The notebook becomes part of your farm's story rather than floating on top of it.

[line]

[size=5][b]❤️ Today Tab — Your Daily Dashboard[/b][/size]

Everything relevant for today, organized at a glance.

[b]Fortune & Weather[/b]
See today's luck and tomorrow's weather the moment you open your notebook, with visual icons for quick reading.

[b]Calendar Events[/b]
Birthdays, festivals, the Traveling Merchant, the Book Seller, and seasonal reminders — all pulled automatically from game data. No setup required.

[b]Birthday Gift Suggestions[/b]
Click a birthday entry to expand it and see the friend's portrait alongside their loved and liked gifts, with item sprites and hover tooltips. No more last-minute wiki searches before heading to town.

[b]Planting Recommendations[/b]
Crops are organized into priority tiers so you always know what to plant:
[list]
[*][b]Tier A[/b] — Highly recommended; multiple harvests possible before season ends[/*]
[*][b]Tier B[/b] — Time-sensitive; plant now or miss the window[/*]
[*][b]Tier C[/b] — Informational; season ends before this crop matures[/*]
[/list]Click any crop icon to instantly create a planting task.

[b]Fishing Recommendations[/b]
Seasonal fish with location info, rain-only alerts, and time-based availability.

[line]

[size=5][b]🌾 Harvest Forecast — Know What's Ready[/b][/size]

The notebook scans your planted crops and shows you:
[list]
[*]Crops ready to harvest today[/*]
[*]Growing crops with days remaining until harvest[/*]
[*]Expected harvest count for multi-harvest crops[/*]
[*]Crop sprites for quick identification[/*]
[/list]Supports Farm, Greenhouse, and Ginger Island. Crops that aren't ready today automatically appear in the Upcoming tab forecast.

[line]

[size=5][b]🔮 Upcoming Tab — Plan Ahead[/b][/size]

See the next three days before you go to sleep.

Includes birthdays, festivals, merchant visits, seasonal reminders, your scheduled tasks, and your upcoming harvests — organized with clear day labels ([i]"Tomorrow"[/i], [i]"In 2 days"[/i], [i]"In 3 days"[/i]).

Handles season transitions and end-of-year cleanly, so you're never surprised by a new season starting.

[line]

[size=5][b]🗓️ Calendar — Full Seasonal Overview[/b][/size]

A complete in-game calendar covering all four seasons. Navigate freely between seasons. Each day shows birthday indicators, festival markers, merchant visits, passive seasonal events, and your personal task count. Click any day to open a detail view with the full event list and your scheduled tasks.

[line]

[size=5][b]✅ Tasks — Reminders That Work the Way You Do[/b][/size]

Create your own reminders with three task types:
[list]
[*][b]One-Time[/b] — Scheduled for a specific date ([i]"Buy Pumpkin Seeds on Spring 12"[/i])[/*]
[*][b]Daily[/b] — Resets every morning ([i]"Check Crab Pots"[/i], [i]"Pet Animals"[/i])[/*]
[*][b]Weekly[/b] — Repeats on a specific day of the week ([i]"Collect Kegs on Monday"[/i])[/*]
[/list]Missed a task? It appears automatically in an [b]Overdue[/b] section so nothing slips through. Want to start a planting task from a crop recommendation? One click — the task is created with the crop icon attached.

[line]

[size=5][b]⭐ Goals — Your Biggest Ambitions[/b][/size]

Track meaningful milestones:
[list]
[*]Complete the Community Center[/*]
[*]Reach Farming Level 10[/*]
[*]Build a Deluxe Barn[/*]
[*]Catch every legendary fish[/*]
[/list]Pin your most important goals to keep them visible at the top. Mark them complete when you get there.

[line]

[size=5][b]📜 Journal — A Record of What You've Done[/b][/size]

Every task you complete is automatically logged with the season, day, and task name. Entries are grouped by day and displayed from newest to oldest. Over time, the journal becomes a natural chronicle of your farm's story — no writing required.

[line]

[size=5][b]📚 Guide Tab — Quick Reference Without Leaving the Game[/b][/size]

[b]Forageables[/b]
Seasonal forage items organized by location, with hover tooltips.

[b]Fish Guide[/b]
Seasonal availability, fishing locations, rain-only flags, and time windows for every catchable fish. Hover over any fish to see how many you've caught and your personal size record.

[b]Community Center Tracker[/b]
Incomplete bundles with required items and remaining quantities. Shows a completion message when the Community Center is done.

[line]

[size=5][b]🌍 Localization[/b][/size]

Automatically follows your game's language setting. Currently available in [b]English[/b] and [b]Brazilian Portuguese[/b]. Additional languages are planned.

[line]

[size=5][b]⚙️ Configuration (Optional)[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to access settings:
[list]
[*]Rebind the notebook hotkey (default: [b]N[/b])[/*]
[*]Show or hide crops you haven't seen yet in planting recommendations[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.1.10 or later[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (optional, for settings)[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[center][b]Press N. Open your notebook. Plan your perfect farm.[/b][/center]

[line]

Downloads.Description: First public release of Farmer's Notebook. Unzip and drop the FarmersNotebook folder into your Stardew Valley Mods directory. Requires SMAPI 4.1.10 or later. Press N in-game to open your notebook.

Manifest.Description: An immersive in-game notebook for Stardew Valley 1.6. Press N to track birthdays, festivals, planting windows, harvests, fish, and manage your own tasks, goals, and journal — all without leaving the game.
